verdict.rationale: Google publishes a machine-readable Discovery Document for each API through the API Discovery Service. The documents are served as unauthenticated JSON at per-API endpoints (e.g. compute.googleapis.com/$discovery/rest?version=v1), and a queryable directory lists them. This counts as an 'equivalent' to OpenAPI, which the story explicitly allows. Missing for 10: the format is Google-proprietary rather than OpenAPI, so standard OpenAPI tooling needs a conversion step; there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of downloading and using the documents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
